critiques.review: The plan correctly slices most business features into modules and keeps pure utilities in shared/. However, several validator warnings reveal misplaced plumbing and impure shared code: two repositories and a service live in shared/, five one‑file platform groups exist, three platform groups (ocr, version, app.controller) actually own tables or routes and belong in feature modules, and utils/editor.ts is only used by platform/media. Moving the offending files to their true owners and re‑classifying the three platform groups as modules removes all warnings without breaking cohesion. No unrelated merges are required.
